# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: As per 爪# (pick/pluck) + 臼 mortar → *dip* a curved *ladle* into a mortar to pluck out selected objects.
抒臼也。从爪、臼。《詩》曰：“或簸或舀。”
廾 here an abbreviated form# of 異 (raise) + 臼 mortar-shaped object → bear an object on the shoulders → *bear on the shoulders*. Compare 擡.
共舉也。从𦥑从廾。凡舁之屬皆从舁。讀若余。

The relevant seal inscription form is 臼 mortar + an element# combining 廾 pair of hands and 午 (pound) → *pound* food in a mortar → *sinking/setting of the sun* (← sink ← pound into the bottom of a mortar). Distinguish 舂 from 春.
擣粟也。从廾持杵臨臼上。午，杵省也。古者雝父初作舂。

鵲 combines 鳥 bird + 昔# for the sound alone to simulate cawing (compare 雅 and 烏) → a Korean magpie. 舃 is a variant form of 鵲 that eventually came to indicate a type of wide-mouthed and *double-soled shoe*, with the "pile" aspect of 昔 lending an atavistic influence (← one sole piled atop another). *Great/huge* and *dry beach/tidelands* are borrowed meanings.
𩁆也。象形。
As per 臼# (stooped) + 男 man → stooped (= older/elderly) human male (compare 久) → *brother(s) of one's mother*; *father of one's husband*.
母之兄弟爲𦥶，妻之父爲外𦥶。从男臼聲。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form shows two objects meshing, to which a seal inscription form adds two pairs of hands → raise an object in unison (compare 擎) → *work jointly*; *participate*. *Give* and *grant* are borrowed meanings.
黨與也。从舁从与。

The relevant seal inscription form combines 同 same + 與# (raise in unison) → work together to *raise*, *build* or *promote* → *interest*; *prosperity* (← raise interest; build up funds). *Prevalent* is an extended meaning.
起也。从舁从同。同力也。

萑 is 隹 short, squat bird + 艸 grass/plant (here acting as a shape indicator, suggesting the curvature of a pair of ears) → horned owl. 舊 adds 臼# (stooped) → owl (← bird of a stooped appearance) → *bent with rot* (compare 朽) → *old*; *former* → *old friend*.
𨾦舊，舊畱也。从雈臼聲。
As per the slender chisel element described in 臿 + 口 mouth → the slender, chisel-like *tongue* enclosed in the mouth, which facilitates *speaking*.
塞口也。从口，氒省聲。(氒，音厥。)
在口，所以言也、別味也。从干从口，干亦聲。凡舌之屬皆从舌。
市居曰舍。从亼、屮，象屋也。口象築也。

捨.explanation: 捨 is used when giving up, abandoning or relinquishing; 舍 remains for dwelling, dormitory and related senses.
捨.example: 舍弃 → 捨棄; 宿舍 → 宿舍
捨.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: An abbreviated form# of 余 (stretch) + 囗 circular enclosure (→ a particular spot) → enclosed place for stretching in relaxation → *resting spot*; *shelter*; *living quarters*. In 舒, 舎 appears in the variant form 舍.

As per 氏# (flat) + 舌 tongue → flatten the tongue on a piece of food in licking it → *lick* → *undergo* (a harsh experience) (← lick something bitter) → *underestimate/underrate* (← undergo a harsh experience on account of underrating a situation or another person ).
As per 予# (stretch) + 舎 (stretch) → *stretch wide/extensively* → *be relaxed/at ease*. Also, *state* or *expostulate* (← propound at length ← stretch).
伸也。从舍从予，予亦聲。一曰舒，緩也。
以舌取食也。从舌易聲。

舎 here was originally 金 metal, which when added to 甫# (spread) yielded the meaning of a metal bracket fitted precisely (= spreading flat) into a gate. (The present-day character 鋪, however, means "lay out; spread; pave.") For 舗, the idea eventually became that of goods *spread flat* for display/sale (compare 販) in a simple structure → *sales* → *store*; *shop*. Note a variant form, 舖.
The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows crossing legs → *go against*; *disobey*; *rebel*. Also, *be mixed (up/together)* and *be mistaken*.
對臥也。从夊𡕒相背。凡舛之屬皆从舛。

The relevant seal inscription form is 舛# crossing legs + an element combining 炎 flame and 匚 shape indicator → move lightly and nimbly around flames enclosed in a hearth, in the manner of a dancing flame. 舜 is associated with the *name of a legendary ruler in ancient China*. Also, via 蕣, the borrowed meaning *Hibiscus syriacus*.
艸也。楚謂之葍，秦謂之藑。蔓地連華。象形。从舛，舛亦聲。凡䑞之屬皆从䑞。(今隸變作舜。)
車軸耑鍵也。兩穿相背，从舛；𥜿省聲。𥜿，古文偰字。
The relevant seal inscription form is as per that described in 無 (perform a dance)# + 舛 crossing legs → figure performing a *dance of entreaty* before the gods → *dance*; *flit*; *glide*.
樂也。用足相背，从舛；無聲。
A depiction of a small, curved *boat* → *ship*.
船也。古者，共鼓、貨狄，刳木爲舟，剡木爲楫，以濟不通。象形。凡舟之屬皆从舟。
As per 山# (dense/lumpy objects) + 舟 boat → *sampan* loaded with a pile of goods. The compound for "sampan" may be rendered 三板 (= "three planks"), 舢板 or 舢舨.
As per 亢# (stretch) + 舟 boat → boats sailing in grand alignment → *sail*; *navigate*; *vessel*.
As per 方# (rafts/boats moored side by side) + 舟 boat → *boats moored to each other* → *boat*. 舫 was devised to replace 方 after 方 acquired its numerous associated and extended meanings.
船師也。《明堂月令》曰“舫人”。習水者。从舟方聲。

The element at left was originally not 舟 but a rounded tray. 殳 action indicator was added to suggest "*carry*/transport a tray on which objects are *spread out*" (compare 販, in which goods are spread on a board for sale) → *circle*; *(in) general*; *all* (← spread of objects from a starting point).
辟也。象舟之旋，从舟。从殳，殳，所以旋也。
As per 令# (long sequence) + 舟 boat → *boat* with a series of windows.

As per 由# (pass/run through) + 舟 boat → *bow/prow* that projects narrowly from the hull of a boat. *Stern* is via a reinterpretation of the character, understanding the projection to be from the rear rather than the front of the vessel. Compare 艫.
艫也。从舟由聲。漢律名船方長爲舳艫。一曰舟尾。
As per 它# (stretch) + 舟 boat → long *rudder* → *helm* (← a boat's steering mechanism in general). Compare 柁.
As per 白# (scatter) + 舟 boat → boats scattered over the surface of a body of water (compare 泊) → *boat*.
As per 玄# (link) + 舟 boat → *gunwale* (or *saxboard*), the top edge of the two sides of a boat, linking the bow to the stern.
As per 可# (bend) + 舟 boat → *large boat* (with a sharply angled prow).
舟也。从舟可聲。
Abbreviated form# of 沿 (follow/run along a prescribed course) + 舟 boat → *boat* progressing along a prescribed course → *ship*.
舟也。从舟，鉛省聲。
孚 an abbreviated form# of 浮 float + 舟 boat → *lighter*; *barge*.
艅艎，舟名。从舟余聲。經典通用餘皇。
As per 廷# (extend) + 舟 boat → long, narrow vessel (such as a dugout canoe) → *small boat*.
小舟也。从舟廷聲。
艅艎也。从舟皇聲。
船著不行也。从舟㚇聲。讀若䔂。
As per 叟# (narrow/thin) + 舟 boat → long, thin *boat* → *counter for boats*.
倉# storehouse + 舟 boat → *hold* (of a ship).
As per 曹# (array) + 舟 boat → fleet of (small) boats → *boat*; *small boat*.
雪 snow + 舟 boat → (boat-shaped) *sleigh*; *sled*. Compare 橇 and 轌.
As per 童# (run through) + 舟 boat → fighting vessel used to ram enemy boats → *warship*.
As per 義# (ceremony) + 舟 boat → ceremony performed in equipping a boat → *equip*; *prepare to launch*. 艤 is effectively a variant form of 檥.
監# keep watch over + 舟 boat → boat equipped with an observation post → *warship*.
魯# (long and drawn out) + 舟 boat. Effectively a variant of 櫓 (*scull*; *oar*).

As per 盧# (sunken) + 舟 boat → *stern* of a boat, that sinks below the waterline. *Bow* and *prow* are via a reinterpretation of the character, understanding the section in question to be at the front rather than the rear of the vessel. Compare 舳.
舳艫也。一曰船頭。从舟盧聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is an abbreviated form of 見 see + 匕 double-pronged eating implement → blade adhering to the eye of a slave who is blinded in having it gouged out. *Northeast* (as a direction in the zodiac) is a borrowed meaning.
很也。从匕、目。匕目，猶目相匕，不相下也。《易》曰：“𥃩其限。”匕目爲𥃩，𠤎目爲眞也。
The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows a grain/kernel being washed in the flow of a pure stream → *good* (← pure) → *superior*; *truly*; *considerably*.
善也。从畗省，亡聲。
As per 艮# (adhere) + 𦰩 as described in 漢 (stretch over a fire) → *distress*; *trouble* (← suffering/hardships consequent to adhering directly to a fire) → *difficult*; *hard*. Compare 難.
土難治也。从堇艮聲。

The relevant seal inscription form combines 巴# (spread) atop a second figure → two persons copulating → *sex*; *lover*; *mistress* → *looks*; *appearance* (← motive factors stimulating the sex drive) → *color* (← complexion ← appearance).
顔气也。从人从卪。凡色之屬皆从色。
弗 here an abbreviated form# of 怫 rage + 色 color/appearance → *face that goes flush with anger*.
色艴如也。从色弗聲。《論語》曰：“色艴如也。”
縹色也。从色并聲。
艷 is 豐 abundance + 色 color/appearance → rich color → *gloss*; *luster*; *sheen* → *sexy*; *seductive*; *bewitching*; *charming*. However, 艷 has been supplanted by 艶.
An abbreviated form of 芻 (cut grass) → *grass*; *plant* (→ grasses and plants in general).
百芔也。从二屮。凡艸之屬皆从艸。
艼熒，朐也。从艸丁聲。
逺荒也。从艸九聲。《詩》曰：“至于艽野。”
As per 乂# (vegetation cut in swaths) + 艸 grass/plant → (cut) *mugwort* (compare 薛) → *moxa*. For moxa, compare 灸.
冰臺也。从艸乂聲。
艸也。从艸乃聲。
葦華也。从艸刀聲。
艸盛也。从艸凡聲。《詩》曰：“芃芃黍苗。”
芄蘭，莞也。从艸丸聲。《詩》曰：“芄蘭之枝。”
相當也。闕。讀若宀。
As per 千# (advance through luxuriant vegetation) + 艸 grass/plant → extensive/*luxuriant (fresh) vegetation*.
艸盛也。从艸千聲。
As per 于# (U-shaped) + 艸 grass/plant → U-shaped *taro* → *potato*. Compare 莒.
大葉實根，駭人，故謂之芌也。从艸亏聲。
As per 勺# (rise and become evident) + 艸 grass/plant → a conspicuous flower. The compound 芍藥 (芍薬) refers to a peony (← flower conspicuous both for its large size and strong fragrance).
鳧茈也。从艸勺聲。
地黃也。从艸下聲。《禮記》“鈃毛：牛、藿；羊、芐；豕、薇。”是。
白苗嘉榖。从艸己聲。

As per 亡# (obscure) + 艸 grass/plant → *beard*/*awn*, the (obscure), sharp tip of a plant → (beam of) *light*. The character has been applied to Miscanthus sinensis, with most Japanese-English dictionaries rendering すすき as *Japanese pampas grass*.
麻母也。从艸子聲。一曰芓卽枲也。
艸也。一曰芘茮木。从艸比聲。
As per 夫# (stretch out/over) + 艸 grass/plant → *water lily* stretching over the surface of a pond → *lotus*. Compare 蓮.
芙蓉也。从艸夫聲。
艸之葟榮也。从艸尹聲。
之# (forward motion) + 艸 grass/plant → (a particular variety of fast-growing) mushroom. *Turf* is a borrowed meaning → *lawn*; *grass*.
神艸也。从艸从之。
刈艸也。从艸从殳。
雞頭也。从艸欠聲。
As per 不# (bulging/swollen bud) + 艸 grass/plant → *swollen bud*. The compound 芣苡 refers to the plantain (compare 芭蕉). 芣 was devised to replace 不 after 不 acquired its borrowed meanings.
華盛。从艸不聲。一曰芣苢。
As per 介# (reduce) + 艸 grass/plant → *mustard* (← plant with the medicinal property of reducing swelling) → *dust*; *trash* (← tiny pieces).
菜也。从艸介聲。
As per 予# (stretch) + 艸 grass/plant → a tall variety of Cyperus. *Oak* is a borrowed meaning via 杼 → *acorn*.
艸也。从艸予聲。可以爲繩。
堇艸也。从艸及聲。讀若急。
艸也。从艸今聲。《詩》曰：“食野之芩。”
芪母也。从艸氏聲。
As per 元# (round) + 艸 grass/plant → variety of *poisonous plant* with round, purple flowers.
魚毒也。从艸元聲。
As per 分# (split) + 艸 grass/plant → split *fragrant* vegetation, releasing its *perfume*.
As per 巴# (spread) + 艸 grass/plant → plant with large, spreading leaves. The compound 芭蕉 refers to Musa basjoo (*banana/plantain* plant).
A variant form of 茁 flourishing vegetation, emphasizing vegetation flourishing at *water's edge*. 内 replaces 出 to indicate a shift in the initial consonant from S- to N-; compare 訥, 吶, 蚋, 汭 and 枘.
芮芮，艸生皃。从艸内聲。讀若汭。
As per 心# (heart of an object) + 艸 grass/plant → *pith* (center) of a soft rush plant → *center*.
支# branch + 艸 grass/plant → *water caltrop* (the fruit of which has branching, well-defined lines). Compare 菱.
蔆也。从艸支聲。
化# transformation + 艸 grass/plant → *flower/blossom* (← part of a plant that undergoes a slow transformation).
As per 方# (spread) + 艸 grass/plant → the spreading *fragrance* of plants (compare 苾 and 菩) → *honorific prefix*.
香艸也。从艸方聲。
菲也。从艸勿聲。
止 here an abbreviated form# of 沚 sandbanks/sandbar + 艸 grass/plant → *angelica* (← plant that flourishes around sandbanks in wetlands).
An abbreviated form of 藝: *skill*; *art*; *accomplishment* .
艸也。似目宿。从艸云聲。《淮南子》說：“芸艸可以死復生。”
As per 斤# (adhere) + 艸 grass/plant → *celery* (that grows in close proximity to bogs, marshes and other bodies of water). *Parsley* is a borrowed meaning.
楚葵也。从艸斤聲。
艸也。味苦，江南食以下气。从艸夭聲。
Doubling of an element combining 勹 an abbreviated form of 包 (encompass/envelop) + 屮 grass shoot → compress *cut* grass into bundles → *mow* → *fodder*; *hay*.
刈艸也。象包束艸之形。
艸覆蔓。从艸毛聲。《詩》曰：“左右芼之。”
As per 牙# (mesh; cross) + 艸 grass/plant → buds that mesh → *bud* → *sprout*; *shoot* → *sign*; *beginnings*; *omen* (← buds, sprouts or shoots as harbingers of something new).
萌芽也。从艸牙聲。

囌.explanation: Specialized alternate character in certain older and regional written forms, particularly speech/onomatopoeic or revival-related words; not the general glyph for Su surnames or the plant name.
囌.usageCaveat: No directly validated OpenCC phrase example for 囌 was found in this review; require a lexicon entry before showing a concrete example.
囌.evidenceScope: Unihan 17.0 forward relationship; lexical use and 2013 official classification not independently exhaustively checked.

蘇.explanation: Common traditional form in many uses, including the phonetic name “Su” and other ordinary lexemes; not interchangeable with 囌 in all specialized contexts.
蘇.evidenceScope: OpenCC 1.4.2 explicitly maps 苏打→蘇打. Other senses require individual lexical check.

sources.basis: Lexical example explicitly found in OpenCC 1.4.2 STPhrases

entries.text: An abbreviated form# of 宛 (bend) + 艸 grass/plant → winding enclosure for flowers, trees or animals → *pasture*; *farm*; *park*; *garden*.
所以養禽獸也。从艸夗聲。
As per 冉# (supple) + 艸 grass/plant → (supple and) *lush/luxuriant* plant life → *flourish*.
As per 令# (long sequence) + 艸 grass/plant → a type of fungus, original identity obscure → *mushroom*. 苓 has also been applied to *licorice*.
卷耳也。从艸令聲。
As per 台# (heavy downward pressure) + 艸 grass/plant → pressure exerted by heavy rocks carpeted with *moss* or *lichen*. Compare 蘚.
艸也。从艸召聲。
蓨也。从艸由聲。
艸# grass/plant + 田 field → sprouts/seedlings (obscured) in a field → *seedling*; *shoot*; *young plant* → *family*; *blood relations*.
艸生於田者。从艸从田。

As per 立# (exert continuous downward pressure) + 艸 grass/plant → *pen* (for pigs or other domesticated animals) erected from heavy, woven plant matter. Also, by way of interpreting the character as 艸 + 立 stand, the herb Angelica dahurica, which stands as high as three meters.
As per 可# (shout/laugh/sing in a loud voice) + 艸 grass/plant → plant that irritates the throat as does shouting → *torment*; *harsh* → *scold*.
小艸也。从艸可聲。
包# envelop + 艸 grass/plant → husk used as wrapping material → *wrap*; *wrapper*. (Variety of) *miscanthus* is a borrowed meaning.
艸也。南陽以爲麤履。从艸包聲。

As per 句# (bend) + 艸 grass/plant → bend grass to temporarily demarcate a small unit of land → *for the time being*. *In the event that*, *considering that*, *if*, *any* and (not) *on any account* are borrowed meanings. Distinguish 苟 from the identical-appearing element in 敬.
艸也。从艸句聲。
以# use + 艸 grass/plant → a plant (original identity uncertain) used for food or medicine. The compound 薏苡 refers to Job's tears/tear grass, while 芣苡 indicates plantain (compare 芭蕉).
芣苢。一名馬舄。其實如李，令人宜子。从艸㠯聲。《周書》所說。
As per 巨# (great/large) + 艸 grass/plant → large plant. The compound 萵苣 refers to lettuce. *Torch* is a borrowed meaning via 炬.
束葦燒。从艸巨聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is a depiction of a supple young women combing her hair. A seal inscription form transforms the hair element into 艸 grass/plant and adds 口 (an object) below, probably under the influence of the seal inscription form of 右 → *youth* (← suppleness of youth) → *immature*. The minor meanings of *either/or*, *some ... while others ...*, and *if* are borrowed meanings.
擇菜也。从艸、右。右，手也。一曰杜若，香艸。

古# hard; dried out + 艸 grass/plant → *bitter* plant that makes the mouth go dry → *stubborn*; *pain*; *agony*; *suffering*; *hardship*; *trying* (experience); *exert oneself*; *worry*; *distress*; *pressure*; *torment*; *torture*; *be at a loss*; *embarrassment*.
大苦，苓也。从艸古聲。

宁# stand tall/still + 艸 grass/plant → *white ramie* (also known as *Chinese silk plant*), the fiber of which was spun on a rack → *hemp*; *hemp thread*. 苧 originally emphasized the plant rather than the fiber, and 紵 the reverse, but the distinction was eventually largely lost.
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 艸 grass/plant → (rush/straw) *mat* fixed upon a floor as a covering. Compare 簟.
蓋也。从艸占聲。

As per 央# (stretch) + 艸 grass/plant → gorgeous plant, stretching at length → *brilliance*; *superiority* (← surpass others ← stretch at length). *England* and *English* are via the phonetic construction 英吉利.
艸榮而不實者。一曰黃英。从艸央聲。
艸也。从艸冬聲。
As per 且# (pile) + 艸 grass/plant → layers of plant matter forming the insole of footwear → *hemp* (← plant used for this purpose). Also, *food/object wrapped in straw*.
履中艸。从艸且聲。
蕛苵也。从艸失聲。
甘艸也。从艸从甘。

As per 平# (floating water weed) + 艸 grass/plant → *floating weed*; *duckweed*. Compare 萍. *Mugwort* is a borrowed meaning. 苹 was devised to replace 平 after 平 acquired its associated and extended meanings.
蓱也。無根，浮水而生者。从艸平聲。

As per 母# (succession of offspring) + 艸 grass/plant → berries (voluminous fruit; compare 梅). In Japan, 苺 has been associated specifically with the *strawberry*. Note a variant form, 莓, in which 毎 may be observed as functioning just as 母 (succession of offspring).
馬苺也。从艸母聲。
付# attach + 艸 grass/plant → *plant* similar to kudzu (← vine that attaches itself to trees, other vegetation etc.).
雕苽。一名蔣。从艸瓜聲。
As per 必# (split) + 艸 grass/plant → *fragrance/aroma* splitting away in being released by a plant → *fragrant*. Compare 芳 and 菩.
馨香也。从艸必聲。
